title: Lock MVP non-goals and scope change control
purpose: Prevent Alpha/Beta/high-security concerns from leaking into the MVP execution path.
scope: Define scope expansion rules and required approval evidence.
Define what belongs to Alpha, Beta, and the high-security product line.
Record risk boundaries that must not be weakened by implementation shortcuts.
deliverables: Updated TASK.md MVP 不做 section
acceptance_criteria: Firecracker productionization, seL4/Genode, multi-tenant, HA, GUI-native, and online self-update are explicitly out of MVP.
The document defines how a deferred item can re-enter scope.
Security bottom lines remain stronger than convenience shortcuts.
No unresolved TODO markers remain in the decision document.
verification: Search the decision document for TODO markers.
Confirm workflow-session.json and TASK.md contain the same non-goal boundary.
commit_policy: Commit immediately after this task is completed.
